script.title: Piplup — A Little Wave
script.description: An oversized, freestanding Piplup greeting you with a raised flipper. Its rounded blue hood, white eye masks, sparkling eyes, golden beak, twin breast buttons and broad webbed feet create a playful character sculpture.
